Display a strategic plan. If id is provided, show that plan; otherwise list

strategic_plan and show the first (e.g. STRAT-PLAN-001).



Respects field-level read permissions (BLI-642). Output format via --format.

  Show primary strategic plan
  zqk.test object splan show
  Show plan by ID
  zqk.test object splan show STRAT-PLAN-001
  Show in JSON format
  zqk.test object splan show --format json

Usage:
  zqk.test object splan show [flags]

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
